whatYouGet.zh-Hant: 免費方案，含 Merge Queue、Merge Protections、CI Insights、Test Insights
whatYouGet.zh-Hans: 免费方案，含 Merge Queue、Merge Protections、CI Insights、Test Insights
whatYouGet.en: Free plan including Merge Queue, Merge Protections, CI Insights and Test Insights

whyItHelps.zh-Hant: 合併前用最新的 main 重新驗證，避免多個各自通過 CI 的 PR 合在一起後把 main 弄壞。
whyItHelps.zh-Hans: 合并前用最新的 main 重新验证，避免多个各自通过 CI 的 PR 合在一起后把 main 弄坏。
whyItHelps.en: Re-validates PRs against the latest main before merging, so individually green PRs don't break main together.

requirements.zh-Hant: 開源專案（公開 repo）免費；私有 repo 則限 5 人以內
requirements.zh-Hans: 开源项目（公开仓库）免费；私有仓库则限 5 人以内
requirements.en: Free for open source projects (public repositories); private repositories are limited to teams of up to 5
